The rod bore matches the fitted R58 shape within 0.042 mm at 55 deposited stations; force and spring compliance cannot be inferred from the bore alone.

Fit the standard pin and clip, then fully seat the retainer with the paddle down. Test central, end and angled clicks and balanced hook retention.
